interpretation: Raw-adapter profiles are acquisition and cache-build measurements. Repeated task training should use canonical_v1 caches and map-style worker sharding, not independent raw iterators.

aidlab_har.raw_parallel_policy: single producer; a complete pass is about 57 ms and independent workers duplicate the archive

c_mhad.raw_parallel_policy: subject-directory sharding scales 3.60x; final typed-CSV conversion removes another measured 16% parsing overhead

crossfit.raw_parallel_policy: independent iterators are safe but each traverses the corpus; shard cached recording indices during training

oca.raw_parallel_policy: one pass reads each of 12 CSV members once; independent iterators duplicate all records

openpack.raw_parallel_policy: archive-level sharding scales 3.22x; final typed usecols parsing is approximately 9% faster than the profiled reader

recofit.raw_parallel_policy: single producer only; the release is one compressed sequential MATLAB variable and four workers decode it four times

wear.raw_parallel_policy: session sharding scales 2.85x; CSV parsing dominates

training_policy.parallelism: map-style disjoint index sampling across workers
training_policy.memory: read-only NumPy memory maps per selected recording
training_policy.semantic_changes: none; no resampling, windowing, imputation, or task-label synthesis

canonical_cache_verification.full_recording_parity: all 6611 cached recordings matched raw identifiers, event boundaries, timestamps, values, and masks exactly
